'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Rick Zuchowski LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Rick Zuchowski]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Pilfn's HB (V). Transcription note: same player as p122 (small-world rule)

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Pilfn
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
